# N26: Home: one primary at most, none when nothing is asked, in the first screen, and none of the words Home no longer says

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/12-home.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Home's one primary, and quiet when quiet (docs/design/home/spec.md, HM1). [HOME-OWNER] On every day of two weeks for four of the demo's people, at a phone's and a computer's size: at most one primary button on Home, and none when there is no lead (the quiet line); the lead's button, and on a phone the first of your goals that needs attention, in the first screen (above the phone's tab bar at 390×844, above the fold at 1440×900); and Home never says "0 weeks", "None you’re in" or "You’re all set", nor links to a bare /goals or an old show= address.

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong

- {at}: Home's lone review cell shows the long label “{seen.loneLong}” on a phone
- {at}: Home has neither a lead nor the quiet line
- {at}: {seen.primaries} primary buttons (passes when `seen.primaries <= 1`)
- {at}: nothing is asked, but Home has a primary button (passes when `seen.primaries === 0`)
- {at}: the quiet line is not one of its sentences
- {at}: the lead’s button ({seen.lead}) is not in the first screen ({Math.round(seen.bottom ?? -1)}px, fold {Math.round(seen.fold)}px) (passes when `seen.primaries === 1`)
- {at}: Home says something it no longer says
- {at}: the first of your goals that needs attention ends at {Math.round(seen.firstGoal)}px, under the fold at {Math.round(seen.fold)}px
- {at}: a bare or old Goals link ({bad.join(' ')})
- {at}: an ask’s waiting line is cut ({seen.cutMeta.join(' | ')})
- Amara, 2026-11-09, {w}px: the list under an ask lead is headed “{also}”
- Rhea, 2026-11-11, {w}px: no late question says “Was due by Tue 10 Nov” first with the warning mark ({metas.map((m) => m.text).join(' | ')})
- Rhea, 2026-11-11, {w}px: an ask’s waiting line is cut short ({cut.join(' | ')})
